Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): M.Sc. or M.Tech from a recognized university in Meteorology or Atmospheric Science or Oceanography with at least 60% marks. Candidate should clear NET or GATE or any CETI Exam.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Rourkela Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 26-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Rourkela JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at NIT Rourkela is 26th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. or M.Tech degree in Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, or Oceanography with at least 60% marks. Additionally, clearing the NET, GATE, or any CETI exam is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in the NIT Rourkela recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government norms for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000 for the first two years and Rs. 42,000 for the third year.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the NIT Rourkela JRF recruitment must be submitted via email. Ensure all required documents are attached and the subject line is correctly mentioned.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the JRF post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is NIT Rourkela located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Rourkela is located in Rourkela, Odisha, with the pincode 769008.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this NIT Rourkela Junior Research Fellow (JRF) recruitment is NITR / SR / 2026 / Advt. - 26ER010 / I / 062.
